name: HP/Agilent 6063B DC electronic load
description: 240 V / 10 A / 250 W single-input DC load: CC, CR and CV, input on with two-click arm, programmable current protection, protection status decoded, volatile saved states 1-6.

quirks.note: The INPUT is what the panel treats as an output: on, it sinks current. INP ON needs confirmation; ALL OUTPUTS OFF sends INP OFF.
No *RST: the Operating Manual's Table 4-6 lists the factory input state as ON, the Programming Manual p. 51 says 0. The panel never sends it.
Register 0 is the power-on state, and losing power during Save 0 corrupts non-volatile memory and forces a recalibration (Operating Manual p. 63). Only slots 1-6, which are lost at power-off.
INP:SHOR (full-scale current / minimum resistance) is not offered.
A protection shutdown leaves INP? = 1 (Prog p. 45). The card reads the status register to show it.
INP:PROT:CLE switches the input back ON if it was on at the trip (Prog p. 50): protection_clear needs confirmation.
Mode and range changes are refused while the input is on: either can step the current (Prog pp. 46, 52).
Rear LCL/RMT sense switch on RMT with no sense leads: voltage readback reads 0 in every mode and the input goes off in CV/CR (Operating Manual p. 43). v_sense_suspect flags it.
Readback is +/-0.1% +/-150 mV (67 mV steps) and +/-0.12% +/-10 mA (27 mA steps). Use a meter for anything finer.
The Programming Manual (06060-90005) is the family guide; it uses the 6060A in examples and says they apply to any electronic load. It does not name the 6063B.

author: Systemstech

manual.title: Agilent Electronic Load Family Programming Manual
manual.pages: ref = page printed on the page (equal to the PDF page). Ranges from the 6060B/6063B Operating Manual 5951-2826, Table 5-1.

input.doc: Switch the load input on (sinking) or off. ON needs confirmed=True, and a script run must be allowed outputs.

set_mode.doc: Select constant current, resistance or voltage. Refused while the input is ON.

set_i_range.doc: Current range. Refused while the input is ON. Going down moves a higher level to the new range's maximum.

set_r_range.doc: Resistance range. Refused while the input is ON.

value.doc: LOW = 0-24 ohm, MID = 24 ohm-24 kohm, HIGH = 240 ohm-240 kohm

set_i.doc: CC level. Refused outside the present current range. Takes effect when CC is the mode and the input is on.

set_r.doc: CR level. Refused outside the present resistance range.

set_v.doc: CV level: the load draws whatever current holds this voltage (up to its rating).

set_ocp.doc: Software current protection level: above it for the delay, the input shuts down (PS).

set_ocp_delay.doc: How long the current may exceed the protection level before shutdown.

ocp_state.doc: Enable or disable software current protection (off at factory default).

protection_clear.doc: Clear latched protection. ALWAYS needs confirmed=True: it switches the input back ON if it was on when protection tripped.

clear_errors.doc: Read and empty the error queue. Reply: errors = the list read.

save_state.doc: Save to volatile slot 1-6 (lost at power-off). Refused while the input is ON. Slot 0 is never written.

recall_state.doc: Recall slot 1-6. ALWAYS needs confirmed=True: a saved state can switch the input ON.

v_meas.doc: input voltage (+/-0.1% +/-150 mV); null when over range

i_meas.doc: input current (+/-0.12% +/-10 mA); null when over range

p_meas.doc: computed input power; null when over range

overload.doc: a reading came back 9.9E+37 (over the measurement range)

input.doc: INP? -- note it stays true through a protection shutdown; see shutdown

faults.doc: active fault bits by name: VF OC OP OT RV OV

shutdown.doc: PS: protection has turned the input off; clears with protection_clear

unregulated.doc: UNR: the load cannot hold its setting (e.g. the source cannot supply the CC level)

v_sense_suspect.doc: sinking > 0.1 A while reading < 0.1 V: check the rear LCL/RMT sense switch

last_error.doc: first error read by the last clear_errors / drain
